NewsArticle.Title: Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: - 12.13 11:59 p.m. pst - 12.14 02:00 a.m. pst On Monday night (1999/12/13), all servers will be offline from 11:59 p.m. until 1999/12/14 2:00 a.m. Nexon upgrades hardware capacity to expand our worlds. - Dark Ages: Online Roleplaying - Nexus: The Kingdom of the Winds - All Web Servers Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
